text: This solution, ADB–MoF–NDRC Initiative for Parametric Flood Insurance (2021) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in People’s Republic of China between Ministry of Finance (MoF, PRC), National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC, PRC), and Asian Development Bank (ADB). The program was implemented in 2021 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
